promise.lead: No app, no account, no password.

join.scan: Customers scan the sign at the counter.
join.code: They give a mobile number and the code from a text.
join.wallet: And the card goes into Apple Wallet or Google Wallet.

scan.stamp: Point your camera at their card. The stamp lands at once.
scan.full: When the card is full, you hand over the reward.

after.rules: Three automatic rules: set them once and they send on their own.

price.free: Design the card and see it on your own phone, free.
price.cancel: Cancel any time. The cards your customers hold keep working.
